About.title: About Me
About.description: Driven by curiosity, continuous learning, and a passion for turning complex problems into simple solutions.

whoIam.title: Who I am
whoIam.paragraph1: I’m a Full Stack Developer with a strong interest in software architecture, backend development, and building solutions that solve real-world problems. I enjoy turning ideas into reliable and scalable applications.
whoIam.paragraph2: Working across both backend and frontend technologies allows me to build complete end-to-end applications, from designing APIs and business logic to creating intuitive and responsive user interfaces.

Projects.title: Projects
Projects.description: Projects built to solve real-world problems, explore new technologies, and continuously improve as a developer.

meuSaldo.title: Meu Saldo
meuSaldo.shortDescription: Personal finance management API designed to help users track transactions and monitor their financial health.
meuSaldo.fullDescription: My Balance is a personal finance management application that helps users organize their finances through transaction tracking, balance monitoring, and account management. The project focuses on providing better financial visibility while applying backend development best practices, including secure authentication, scalable architecture, and maintainable code structure.

lottus.title: Lottus
lottus.shortDescription: Academic library management platform built with Clean Architecture, Redis caching, and asynchronous processing.
lottus.fullDescription: Lottus is a full-stack academic library management platform developed with a scalable backend architecture focused on performance, maintainability, and separation of concerns. The backend follows Clean Architecture principles and integrates Redis caching, RabbitMQ asynchronous processing, JWT authentication, and Dockerized infrastructure to support modern enterprise-grade development practices.

lottusMobile.title: Lottus Mobile
lottusMobile.shortDescription: Mobile reading management platform designed for parents and students.
lottusMobile.fullDescription: Lottus Mobile is a full-stack platform designed to help parents track and manage their children's school reading activities. The project includes a secure Spring Boot backend API and a React Native mobile application, focusing on authentication security, modular architecture, and scalable mobile-first experiences.

escalaDoReino.title: Escala do Reino
escalaDoReino.shortDescription: Church ministry scheduling platform designed to simplify team organization and service planning.
escalaDoReino.fullDescription: Escala do Reino is a personal project designed to help churches organize ministry schedules, coordinate volunteer teams, and improve service planning. The platform focuses on providing a secure and scalable foundation through role-based access control, schedule management, and modern backend development practices built with Spring Boot.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.shortDescription: Personal developer portfolio showcasing projects, skills, and a custom CMS built with Spring Boot, Next.js, and React.
portfolio.fullDescription: This portfolio was designed to showcase my projects, technical skills, and approach to software development through a modern full-stack application. The frontend is built with Next.js and React, focusing on responsive design, reusable components, and user experience. The backend is being developed with Spring Boot using a modular monolith architecture, providing a custom CMS for managing portfolio content, authentication, and contact communication. The project emphasizes scalability, maintainability, and real-world software engineering practices.
